shortDescription: Imou Ranger 2 Wi-Fi 6 Smart Security Camera Indoor 3MP IPC-K2E2P-3H3W (2K 3MP High-Definition Video / Wi-Fi 6 Technology / 360-Degree Panoramic Coverage / Smart AI Human Detection & Auto Tracking / Two-Way Audio Comm
descriptionHtml:
Imou Ranger 2 Wi-Fi 6 Smart Security Camera Indoor 3MP IPC-K2E2P-3H3W (2K 3MP High-Definition Video / Wi-Fi 6 Technology / 360-Degree Panoramic Coverage / Smart AI Human Detection & Auto Tracking / Two-Way Audio Communication / Night Vision / Privacy Mode / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Keep your home and indoor spaces protected with the Imou Ranger 2 Wi-Fi 6 Smart Security Camera Indoor 3MP (Model IPC-K2E2P-3H3W), available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Upgraded with modern Wi-Fi 6 technology for faster, more reliable connectivity, this indoor smart camera delivers crystal-clear 3MP 2K resolution video, complete 360-degree pan-and-tilt coverage, AI-powered human detection with dynamic motion tracking, and real-time two-way audio for complete peace of mind.
